bbox_convention: Half-open [x,y,x+w,y+h]. Minimum 48px separation; labels outside all artwork crops.
palette_decision: Dark rounded nose; ice inner ears; low-opacity ice blush. No pink anywhere.

concept.interpretation: The fox stays composed and comfortable while its scene changes. Unbreakable already means survives in every scene.
concept.prohibited_trait: No stretching, growing or shrinking trait. Ordinary uniform scaling is only used for scene layout and raster proofs.

geometry.ears: Wide-based, lateral and short; explicit species correction supersedes the previous tall-ear height rule.
geometry.geometry_note: Pose crouching and tail enclosure reduce visible height; infant head/body relation remains approximately two heads tall, with head allowed larger.
geometry.ruff: Six irregular overlapping rounded cheek lobes; no whisker dots.
geometry.tail: A continuous rear plume and return sweep, built from overlapping elliptical fur lobes; no smooth thin kitten tail.
geometry.roundness: Ear polygons are dilated with circular caps >=8% of their smaller dimension; all other shapes use ellipses, rounded rectangles or round-ended arcs.

rendering: Pillow only; 2560px masters. Every 96/64/32/16px proof and 192px thumb is LANCZOS-downsampled from unchanged master art. Silhouettes use unchanged full-art alpha and one snow ink.

directions.name: muff
directions.idea: Tail over nose, eyes closed, comfortable asleep while snow settles on the fur.
directions.principle: Unbreakable: a snow-covered sleeper remains comfortable without a shelter.
directions.cute: YES: tucked cheeks, soft sleeping eyelids and a tail duvet keep the pose cozy.
directions.fox: YES: short outward ears, a rough fur ruff and an immense lobed tail folded over the muzzle carry the winter-fox reading.
directions.tiny: 16px: ear nubs and a huge curled tail remain; the sleepy face is lost. Not a self-explanatory species icon.

cuteness_review.reason: YES: tucked cheeks, soft sleeping eyelids and a tail duvet keep the pose cozy.

species_review.reason: YES: short outward ears, a rough fur ruff and an immense lobed tail folded over the muzzle carry the winter-fox reading.

reasons.rime: Best combination of huge tail, short side ears, affectionate gaze and an unmistakable adverse scene.
reasons.cache: Strong wrapping composition; chin and paws connect the cute character to the enclosed data.
reasons.muff: Most species-specific resting behaviour; enormous tail covers the nose in snow.
reasons.gale: Direct performance of Silent and Unbreakable; weather adds some noise.
reasons.listen: Quiet curiosity with a clear search metaphor; scene is less extreme.
reasons.boreal: A calm continuation of the same animal in darkness; aurora costs pixels.
reasons.chirps: Affectionate ecosystem illustration; two animals need more space.
reasons.pounce: Cute and fox-specific activity, but the angled pose is least clear at tiny sizes.

recommendation.favicon: No production favicon selected: all scene meanings and some species details weaken at 16px.
